name: mirage
text: Short answer: probably yes, but it depends on what kind of timer. A scheduled routine (like the ones that run this repo's rotation) is stored on Anthropic's side and fires at its time whether or not an earlier session ran out of usage; it just needs usage available when it fires. At 3am yours has reset (2:50am), so it should run. A timer that lives inside one open session (a wakeup or loop set by that session) dies if that session is cut off, so it would not fire. Rule of thumb: scheduled routine = survives, in-session timer = does not. If the usage limit is still on at fire time, that run is skipped or fails, it doesn't queue and retry.
